_comment: Shared source vocabulary (spec: dataseries.org spec/multilingual/2-design.md §5d). Hand-maintained, like categories.json — the exception in data/. Datasheets declare `- **source**: <key>`; the pipeline resolves key -> this name object into every sidecar + catalog row, so an institution's name is translated once, not per dataset.
